entries.title: Yarn rejects the Node engine
entries.root_cause: The workflow uses Node 18 while windmill-ledger requires Node 20 or newer. Configure setup-node to install a compatible Node version.

entries.title: Settlement rounding test fails
entries.root_cause: The settlement rounding implementation rounds a half-cent down where the contract requires rounding up. Correct the rounding behavior in the settlement calculation.

entries.title: Yarn rejects the Node engine again
entries.root_cause: The workflow uses Node 18 while windmill-ledger requires Node 20 or newer. Configure setup-node to install a compatible Node version.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request runs on a different runner with a different Node 18 patch version and exits during a frozen install.

entries.title: Preview base URL is missing
entries.root_cause: The preview verification step does not receive WINDMILL_PREVIEW_BASE_URL. Supply the preview URL to that step.
